verdict.rationale: Avalara ships an official MCP server exposing nexus definitions, transaction retrieval/creation, and tax calculation tools (avalara-docs-6,7,8,13,17,18), plus REST APIs for nexus and transactions (avalara-docs-5,15,16,23), giving an agent read/act access to nexus status and transaction/liability data. However, the pack shows no explicit MCP/API surface for 'registrations' status or 'upcoming filings' (filing lives in a separate Managed Returns API product, avalara-docs-31, not shown integrated into MCP), and no documentation of scoped-credential/permission model for the MCP surface. missing for 10: upcoming filings and registration-status endpoints exposed via MCP/API, documented scoped-credential/auth model for agent access.
